 Riley Kugel Returns to UCF With Something to Prove: 'Put the World on Notice Again'
 UCF basketball guard Riley Kugel is back in Orlando after spending the summer with the Los Angeles Clippers' Summer League team. The Knights' leading scorer last season discussed his return to college basketball, uncertainty surrounding his eligibility.
 Andrew Cherico VIP 0 
 UCF guard Riley Kugel signed a Summer League contract with the Los Angeles Clippers to begin his professional basketball career over the summer, but an opportunity to return to the collegiate level was a no-brainer for Kugel.
 Given the ever-changing landscape of college basketball, Kugel didn't hesitate to rejoin a Knights team he helped lead to the NCAA Tournament last season. As an Orlando native, he's happy to be back home, but he knows the opportunity could go away at any moment.
 (Photo: Nate Hill/Staff , 247Sports)
